law: Implementation fails suite -> repair the implementation. Modifying any RC-F1..RC-F14 expectation, the CustodyDecisions interface, or STRICT requires a formal, named founder act with evidence the LAW or the INSTRUMENT was wrong — never that an implementation was inconvenient.
additive_law_permitted: New law may be ADDED at its own address with its own falsifiers and defeat candidates. Adding never edits a frozen file; a frozen file's blob hash is the mechanical test.

deliberately_not_frozen.tests/constitutional/review-custody/matr: the instrument that RUNS the law; extending it to run additional suites does not weaken the law it runs
deliberately_not_frozen.scripts/review-custody.ts: the CLI shell; it composes the core and may adopt additional gates
deliberately_not_frozen.tsconfig.review-custody.json: typecheck configuration; widening its include set cannot weaken a falsifier

note: Blob hashes, not a commit diff: they survive history rewriting and say exactly which bytes are law.
